evidences.evidence_quote: Reference [50] proposes an RFID-based acoustic eavesdropping method that utilizes RFID tags near the target user.
evidences.evidence_context: In recent years, researchers have exploited RF technologies (e.g., WiFi, RFID, mmWave) to perform eavesdropping attacks... Reference [50] proposes an RFID-based acoustic eavesdropping method that utilizes RFID tags near the target user. These methods [50], [51], [53], [54] suffer from insufficient vibration resolution due to the long wavelength and low packet rate.
